_comment: issue #1693 AC5 — the pre-change quality checklist maps completely to the core checklist and the five advanced groups the #1693 relocation targeted (issue #1692 later added a sixth group, quality-group-compatibility, carrying new non-relocated obligations that are not part of this map); every protection retains its strength and appears once. Each entry maps one pre-change checklist obligation to its single post-change owner, keyed on a distinctive phrase PRESENT in that owner. lib/test/modules/create-issue-contract.sh asserts: the phrase is present in its owner; a group-owned obligation's phrase is ABSENT from the always-loaded set (SKILL.md + issue-template.md), proving it left the always-loaded path and appears once behind the router; a core-owned obligation's phrase is present in issue-template.md. Owner is `core` (issue-template.md) or a quality-group stem.

entries.phrase: Title is clear, action-oriented, and scoped to one feature/fix
explains the "why" and names who benefits
Desired Behavior is stated as one decided behavior, not a menu
Technical Context opens with the standardized scope note, included verbatim
Technical context cites real file paths / class names from this project
Open cross-issue prerequisites are listed in `## Dependencies`
Acceptance criteria are measurable, testable, and unconditional
Each AC states what is true after the change rather than what the diff contains
Criterion apparatus is sorted by the consequence test and the grounding block opens the section
No AC forbids a surface (a path, a file class, a tier) that another AC's discharge must touch
Implementation notes describe a single chosen approach
Testing Strategy is a residual-risk supplement, not a restated criterion list
No-options gate passed
Any unresolved decision is in `## 🚫 Blocked`, phrased as a question
Edge cases and error handling are considered
Architecture constraints are explicitly noted
Documentation references are accurate
carries the reproduction facts — triggering steps or input, observed result, expected result, and environment
The Visual Specification section carries what a UI change requires; non-UI issues omit it entirely
A quantitative AC names its measurement instrument
A value-comparison AC states its comparison in the words the producing surface emits
Every universal quantifier the body asserts about the system under change is grounded
An AC establishing a trust or integrity boundary over executable artifacts defines the protected set over the transitive closure
Every enumerated test/case/example list inside an AC declares its closure
A Testing Strategy enumerating a case matrix for a convention-governed surface carries the full matrix
The draft's own unstated mechanism dependencies have their existence determined
Every relied-on third-party behavior went through the WebFetch → WebSearch → ask-the-user ladder
Every "Verified:" bullet carries a self-contained re-derivation handle
A premise verified as "the code does X" was read with its enclosing gates
A designed LLM/semantic-judgment surface over third-party text carries the input-is-data guard AC paired with a hostile-input
